note: Peru, read on the National Superintendency of Migration's procedure pages on gob.pe (read 2026-10-30): the change to the worker resident status and the change to permanent residence. A foreigner with a labour contract of at least a year (approved by the labour authority) or a services contract of at least a year changes to worker resident through Migraciones' digital agency, paying S/ 161.40 at the Banco de la Nación or Págalo.pe; the result comes within 30 working days, and the stay is 365 days, renewable. It rests on the contract with the employer (work for the sponsor); a contract with a trial period or under a year calls for the temporary worker status instead, and a performer's short engagement is the temporary artistic status (the work engine's route). After 3 consecutive years as a worker, investor, researcher or religious resident, without more than 183 consecutive days abroad in a 365-day period, a foreigner may ask for permanent residence, decided within 30 working days; its fee and the work it allows were not on the page, so it is not kept as a route of its own. Naturalisation's years, the Andean Community and Mercosur residence agreements, and the Legislative Decree 1350 itself were not read.

sources.title: Solicitar cambio de calidad migratoria trabajador residente, Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (gob.pe, último cambio 22 abril 2024)
sources.said: El plazo de permanencia es de 365 días prorrogables. ... Toma en cuenta que si el contrato laboral contempla periodos de prueba o es de un plazo inferior a un año, ... Copia del contrato laboral (con una antigüedad máxima de 30 días calendario) y aprobado por la autoridad de trabajo indicando un plazo igual o superior a un año. ... S/ 161.40 ... En un plazo de 30 días hábiles

sources.title: Solicitar cambio a calidad migratoria permanente residente, Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (gob.pe, último cambio 27 noviembre 2024)
sources.said: Si eres un extranjero y has residido durante 3 años en el Perú de forma consecutiva, ya sea como trabajador, inversionista, investigador o perteneciente a alguna comunidad religiosa, puedes solicitar el cambio a la calidad migratoria permanente ... Ahí recibirás el resultado en un plazo de 30 días hábiles . ... Último cambio 27 noviembre 2024
